config system interface
    edit "wan"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping fgfm
        set type physical
        set role wan
    next
    edit "lan"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.1.99 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh fabric
        set type hard-switch
        set role lan
    next
    edit "fortilink"
        set vdom "root"
        set fortilink enable
        set ip 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.0
        set type aggregate
        set member "a"
    next
end
